svg.title: DeepPrint: frozen backbone and cosine probability templates
svg.desc: Checked against src/Training/train.cpp, trainConfig.h, augment.cpp and src/Algorithm/encoder.cpp; Frozen backbone and trainable branch projections feed a normalized 512-dimensional fingerprint embedding, a trainable Cosine Classifier and Softmax. The 30-dimensional Softmax output is the fingerprint template.
svg.text: Gray8 /255 → AA bilinear resize → Gabor binarization
Per-model score = raw cosine of probability templates (0 to 1).
N: batch size. Core uses the minimum successful matching-DB / combined score.
